hypothesis: Daily cross-sectional 5-day momentum long/short may produce different payoffs from the weekly and breakout strategies; published findings on different markets and years are inspiration, not validation.
window: 2023-01-01 through 2026-06-30 UTC inclusive; warmup from earlier verified bars
common_rules: At 00:00 UTC rank with last completed 4h bar at 20:00 previous day. Enter/rebalance at next 04:00 bar open. Positions checked at each 4h bar for 5% stop or gap; daily closed-equity reported at 00:00 UTC boundary. Min median 4h quote turnover over prior 7 days $5m, complete 5 or 20-day history. No orders when insufficient eligible pairs. Explicit fees 0.06% per side, adverse slippage 0.04% per side, actual archived funding events at last trade price proxy; favorable intrabar funding on a stop bar excluded. Exit at next 04:00 rebalance or stop, positions of losing stopped pairs never re-enter before next daily rebalance.
selection: Study the 2023-2024 window only. Eligible if its 2023-2024 return positive and maximum daily marked-to-market drawdown <=20%, and all active bars present. Rank by return; tie by smaller drawdown. 2025-2026 diagnostic, previously seen, not untouched out of sample. Prior strategy trial count incomplete.
decision: Compare selected daily family against prior R17.07 pair_fixed; do not promote if 2026 does not materially improve and independent production-quality venue data are absent.
interpretation: Retrospective research. Earlier study used different instruments, smaller universe, and older period. Official mark-price funding history and true orderbook spreads are unavailable. No claim of 20% monthly or risk-free returns.
